description: Source code for a library managing signal handling, file output, threading, and cleanup routines, specifically for a module named 'crtl_lib'. It includes signal registration, thread management, and cleanup functions.

methods.name: crtl_log_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a certain log level is enabled based on current global settings.

methods.name: crtl_init
methods.description: Initializes the module, sets up output file, signal handlers, and threading, and redirects stdout/stderr.

methods.name: crtl_fsync
methods.description: Synchronizes output to disk, depending on whether in interactive mode.

methods.name: crtl_term
methods.description: Terminates the module, signals thread to exit, restores stdout/stderr, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: crtl_signals_register
methods.description: Registers signal handlers for termination and fault signals.

methods.name: crtl_signal_handler
methods.description: Handles received signals, performs cleanup, and re-raises signals.

methods.name: crtl_abort
methods.description: Performs cleanup and flushes data to disk in case of crash or signal.
